status: experimental: frozen for the forward test, not validated on future data
description: Ridge-logistic combination of the gated node scores. Score = sum(coef[i] * x[i]); positive -> Up, negative -> Down, zero -> no call. Coefficients may be negative: that is the point (fast trend nodes vote against the move). Scale is arbitrary; only the sign matters.
features: x[i] = mean over the [updown] timeframes (those where node i has a score) of node score * gate multiplier of node i's group; evaluated with every node enabled, on candles closed before the question starts.

backtest.note: always-Up scored 52.4% (BTC) and 51.4% (ETH) out of sample; the edge over it is within noise

review_rule: Review after 180 logged days. Promote only if the learned model beats both the shipped strategy and always-Up on the pooled set and on at least 5 of the 7 symbols. Agents report numbers and never change or retrain the model.
